title: Direct Unattended Cremation
description:
The provision of the Funeral Director's services and attending to all necessary arrangements for the direct unattended cremation without guests permitted at Cromer Crematorium, who would choose the date and time of the direct unattended cremation.
Removal of your loved one into our Chapel of Rest.
A Simple Coffin with a name plate.
Provision of the Private Ambulance and Funeral Director from our Chapel of Rest at 32 West Street to Cromer Crematorium.
Inform the next of kin once the ashes are ready to collect.
Additional Services Available - Dressing £50.00, Viewing £50.00.

title: Direct Unattended Burial
description:
A burial without Ceremony, known as an unattended burial, is for those, who for various reasons, prefer not to have a funeral service. This option of a simple, straightforward burial is now being chosen by a growing number of people.

Services included in this option:

• All our Professional Services.

• Removal of your loved one to our Chapel of Rest.

• A Simple Coffin with name plate.

• Grave Marker Cross.

• Grave Digging Fee.

• Suitable vehicle to travel to Churchyard/Cemetery.

*Please note this does not include Burial Fee which range typically from £399.00 (Church of England fee for Churchyards).

title: The Poppy Chapel
description:
The provision of the Funeral Director's services and attending to all necessary arrangements for the direct unattended cremation without guests permitted at a local Crematorium, who would choose the date and time of the direct unattended cremation or burial.
A memorial service or blessing in our Poppy chapel, either prior to or after the cremation, for up to 8 guests.
Removal of your loved one into our Chapel of Rest.
A Simple Coffin with name plate.
Care and preparation of your loved one dressed in own clothes or a gown.
Provision of the Private Ambulance and Funeral Director from our Chapel of Rest at 32 West St, Cromer to the Crematorium.
Inform next of kin once the ashes are ready to collect.

title: Simple Cremation
description:
The provision of the Funeral Director's services and attending to all necessary arrangements for the early service cremation at Cromer Crematorium including booking the families choice of date (Monday to Friday) at 9:30am or 4:30pm.
Removal of your loved one into our Chapel of Rest.
A Standard Coffin with name plate.
Care and preparation of your loved one dressed in own clothes or a gown.
Provision of the Hearse, Funeral Director, and Bearers from our Chapel of Rest at 32 West Street, Cromer, to the local Crematorium.
Inform the next of kin once the ashes are ready to collect.
*If you would like us to arrange a Minister or Celebrant to conduct the service, this can be arranged subject to additional fee £240.00.

title: Supreme Cremation
description:

Removal of your loved one into our Chapel of Rest.
An Standard Coffin with handles and name plate.
Provision of the Hearse, Funeral Director, and Bearers from our Chapel of Rest at 32 West Street, Cromer, to the local Crematorium.
*If you would like us to arrange a Minister or Celebrant to conduct the service, this can be arranged subject to additional fee £240.00.

title: Standard Funeral
price: Cremations from £4100.00 / Burials from £3850.00 including disbursements
description:
The provision of the Funeral Director's services and attending to all necessary arrangements for the full funeral service and cremation or burial including a Minister or Civil Celebrant.
Removal of your loved one into our Chapel of Rest and visits (if required), arranged during office hours.
Care and preparation of your loved one dressed in own clothes or a gown.
A Traditional Coffin with handles and plate.
Provision of the Hearse, Funeral Director, and Bearers from our Chapel of Rest at 32 West Street, Cromer to the funeral service location if different from the choice of Crematorium or place of Burial.
*Church yard only - please ask for Town Council burial costings.

title: Service of Remembrance
description:
A Service of Remembrance for Military Veterans

A Remembrance funeral is a fitting way to pay tribute to the brave men and women who have served in the armed forces. Providing a dignified farewell and remembering those who have served and defended their country. Providing an opportunity to honour their service, sacrifices and pay our respects.

This package includes all the provisions of our Standard Funeral as well as our Union Jack flag to shroud the coffin, Provision of a Poppy wreath and a 'Poppy Fields' scatter tube (as above image).

A bugle player to perform The Last Post (subject to availability).

*A standard-bearer can be arranged (subject to availability).

title: Traditional Funeral
price: Cremations from £4500.00 / Burials from £4150.00 including disbursements
description:
The provision of the Funeral Director's services and attending to all necessary arrangements for the full funeral service and cremation or burial including a Minister or Civil Celebrant.
Removal of your loved one into our Chapel of Rest and visits (if required), arranged at any time, including outside of office hours.
Care and preparation of your loved one dressed in own clothes or a gown.
An Traditional Coffin with handles and name plate.
Provision of the Hearse, Funeral Director, and Bearers from our Chapel of Rest at 32 West Street, Cromer to the funeral service location if different from the choice of Crematorium or place of Burial.
Printing and design of up to 50 orders of service booklets.
Supply of our 7-seater limousine with driver to collect family from a designated address and transport to the funeral service if different from the choice of Crematorium or place of burial and then onto the wake location.

title: Horse Drawn Carriage Funeral
description:
Based on our Standard Funeral Package with Standard Coffin, to include a horse and carriage going via a chosen address and onto a local Crematorium or Church.

• The provision of the Funeral Director's services and attending to all necessary arrangements for the full funeral service and cremation or burial including a Minister or Civil Celebrant.

• Removal of your loved one into our Chapel of Rest and visits (if required), arranged during office hours.

• Care and preparation of your loved one dressed in own clothes or a gown.

• An Elm Coffin with handles and plate.

• Provision of the Funeral Director and Bearers from our Chapel of Rest at 32 West Street, Cromer to the funeral service location if different from the choice of Crematorium or place of Burial.

• *Church yard only - please ask for County Council burial costings.
